about: Modwerk source-only macro-mode package for Digitakt II OS 1.17, compiled from sdk/digitakt-ii/modules/macro-mode.

mods.title: Macro Mode
mods.summary: Hold PAGE and press MOD: encoders A-H become eight macro knobs, each moving up to four sound parameters on the tracks you choose.
mods.description: Eight performance macros on their own page. Each macro moves up to four parameters, chosen from a list like the stock modulation setup's, each with its own depth and its own tracks. The macros ride on top of the sound as the stock modulators do: the kit never changes, and a macro cannot be recorded or locked. A project has one setup, saved in the project file with the knob positions.
mods.author: toonst
mods.on_unit: Not run on a unit yet.
